pass_summary: All 12 tasks are implemented and wired end-to-end: Chair is fully removed, staff/customer dropdowns show labels, an owner all-staff calendar exists, an owner-gated per-artist profile editor exists with correct self-vs-owner gating, inline new-customer booking creation mints a welcome email and defaults new bookings to confirmed, customer auth (scrypt + JWE cookie + set-password token lifecycle with expiry reissue) is built and consumed by gated web sign-in/set-password/passport pages with ownership-checked cancellation requests, and admin surfaces cancellation-request badges. Core package tests (149) pass; the diff is clean of chair/chairId residue and of leaked staff-auth imports on the web origin.

issues.title: Rate limiter is in-memory / per-process
issues.description: apps/web/src/app/account/actions.ts uses createRateLimiter (apps/web/src/lib/rate-limit.ts) which is an in-memory counter. This is fine for the current single-instance dev/deploy target and is tested (actions.test.ts asserts the limiter fires), but it will not share state across multiple server instances/replicas in a scaled deployment, silently weakening the brute-force mitigation the plan's risk table calls for.
issues.suggested_fix: Note in deploy docs that horizontal scaling requires swapping to a shared store (e.g. Redis) for the rate limiter, or accept as a known limitation for the current single-instance deployment.

issues.title: signInAction email casing/whitespace not normalized
issues.description: apps/web/src/app/account/actions.ts signInSchema only validates email shape via z.string().email(); signInCustomer (packages/core/src/services/customer-auth.ts) does an exact-match `where: { email }` lookup. If a customer's welcome email was created with different casing than what they type at sign-in, sign-in will silently fail with the generic 'incorrect' message.
issues.suggested_fix: Normalize email (trim + toLowerCase) consistently at both createCustomerWithWelcome and signInCustomer, or document that email must match exactly as stored.
